purpose: Review explainable command, identity, and telemetry-integrity anomalies with evidence and limitations, without attributing behavior to a person.
primaryGoal: Inspect the selected vehicle's paginated findings, severity, confidence, observation times, supporting evidence and data quality while retaining explicit non-attribution and unsupported-capability warnings.

dataSources.contract: SentinelPage extends AdvancedPage<SentinelFinding>; snake_case source fields, quality, limitations and generated_at.
dataSources.behavior: Positive vehicle enablement, vehicle/limit/offset-specific cache keys, inherited query policy and AbortSignal forwarding already exist. Handler delegates to service.BehavioralSentinel; algorithm, source repositories, windows and runtime response quality were not audited.
dataSources.endpointVerification: Source route composition matches; no HTTP request executed.
dataSources.display: Confidence and quality use current number-format preferences; timestamps use shared formatDateTime with browser-default locale/timezone when no options are passed. No physical-unit conversion is needed for inspected sentinel fields.

dataSources.behavior: Effective selection uses validated URL vehicle scope, persisted selection, then first fleet vehicle. Page consumes selection and does not introduce a competing picker.
dataSources.endpointVerification: Frontend hook inspected; fleet handler and runtime response not independently audited.

components.name: PageLayout
components.contract: PageContainer adapter with w-full/min-w-0 container; preserve shell scope ownership.

components.name: InsightPanel
components.contract: title/description/empty/emptyMessage/query/sourceState/error/onRetry; delegates to LayoutCard and SourceContent, preserves retained data and retry.

components.name: LayoutCard
components.contract: Persistent labelled Card, title/description/actions/footer and accessible description help.

components.contract: Caller-owned page/pageSize/total/onPageChange; native controls, aria-current, live counts and validated direct jump.

components.name: FadeIn
components.contract: Uses useMotionPreference; reduced entrance sets initial=false.

components.name: Badge / Text / KVList / EmptyState
components.contract: Reuse category imports and semantic typography/status/metadata; internals not fully inspected.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Evidence summaries appear within each finding and again in the aggregate EvidencePanel. This is purposeful local-versus-page context, not grounds for deleting either view. Both use hand-rendered bullet paragraphs.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Keep both contexts; reuse a domain evidence-list renderer only if it can preserve per-finding concise content versus aggregate source/time/sample metadata.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Finding and aggregate limitations use parallel bullet paragraph markup and distinct empty behavior.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Prefer one domain limitations-list presentation with optional localized empty copy, without flattening finding limitations into page limitations.

sourceBehavior.detail: Finding header wraps top-level groups; inner icon/title row and severity/confidence row do not wrap.
Finding evidence/limitations stack below md and use two columns above it.
Aggregate quality/evidence/limitations stack until lg, then become three columns.
Existing full-width min-w-0 layout adapter is already adopted.
Shared pagination uses container-aware page controls, wrapping and 44px small-screen controls; preserve this migration.

issues.rule: MDC-043 / narrow containers and extreme content
issues.detail: Unbroken server finding_type/source text and the nonwrapping badge pair have no local min-w-0/break-word strategy. At 320px or long translations they may overflow despite the outer flex-wrap. This is a source-backed risk, not observed clipping.
issues.fix: Allow inner header items to shrink/wrap, keep decorative icon shrink-0, and wrap unbroken identifiers/source text without truncating evidence.

responsive.runtime: unverified; themes, RTL, zoom, long content and allocated container widths not exercised

sourceStrengths.detail: Decorative icons are aria-hidden and findings retain semantic article/h3 markup.
Three aggregate sections carry localized aria-labels.
Card shell has generated title association; description help remains a named keyboard button.
Pagination is named navigation with current-page semantics, labelled controls and live count text.
Reduced-motion source branch exists; actual OS behavior unverified.

issues.detail: Evidence and limitation collections use literal bullet characters inside paragraphs, so item count/list relationships are not encoded. Aggregate lists repeat the same pattern at EvidencePanel.tsx:62,109,121.
issues.fix: Use semantic ul/li with existing Text roles and retain all source content, localized headings and empty explanations.

accessibility.keyboardFocusScreenReaderContrastTouch: unverified; source semantics are not accessibility acceptance

states.initialLoading: Findings query enters InsightPanel loading and SourceContent skeleton; attribution and aggregate panel remain present.
states.empty: Findings show selected-vehicle prerequisite or no-supported-findings EmptyState; resolved empty query can refresh. EvidencePanel has quality/evidence/aggregate-limitations fallbacks.
states.fatalError: Findings use source-local ErrorDisplay and retry through query.refetch; no whole-page content deletion.
states.retained: InsightPanel maps stale DataState to retained SourceContent with non-blocking notice/retry while keeping findings.
states.pausedOffline: Initial paused query uses distinct unresolved/paused role=status copy; retained paused query maps to stale. No distinct page-specific offline timestamp is passed.
states.unknownPartial: Quality status/coverage/reasons are displayed when available, but aggregate metadata has no query trust input.

issues.rule: MDC-026 / unknown is not unsupported or empty
issues.detail: EvidencePanel receives only payload fields, not the query. While pending, paused, failed or vehicle-unselected, it presents 'Quality metadata is unsupported', 'No supporting evidence was returned', and 'No additional limitations were returned' as if a response resolved. Findings correctly distinguish these states through InsightPanel.
issues.fix: Extend existing EvidencePanel to accept optional query/trust state and prerequisite content, preserving its shell, three sections and static unsupported warnings; display unresolved/loading/fatal/retained context without inferring missing source capabilities.

issues.detail: A finding with no limitations renders a labelled but blank limitations box, unlike aggregate limitations' explicit empty copy.
issues.fix: Add localized per-finding 'no limitations returned' copy without implying there are no actual limitations.

states.runtime: all states unverified; no query or browser interaction executed

visualIssues.detail: Finding card and evidence box use fixed-white borders/background (also line 91). EvidencePanel evidence tiles repeat fixed-white styling at line 81. Low alpha is not pure-white text, but these surfaces bypass neutral theme tokens.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing neutral surface/border tokens or current Card styling; retain article boundaries and subsection separation.

visualIssues.detail: Every finding's limitations box gets amber decoration regardless of severity; EvidencePanel repeats an amber unsupported box at line 117 and the page has a permanent warning banner. This may overemphasize generic caveats relative to findings; visual strength has not been measured.
visualIssues.fix: Keep warning meaning and all caveats, but prefer neutral subsection surfaces and restrained semantic accents only where warning priority is meaningful.

visualIssues.detail: The warning variant used here explicitly uses border-neon-amber/25 and bg-neon-amber/10. The other shared variants also use neon-named accent classes. This is dependency source evidence, not proof of fluorescent pixels or permission to rename persisted theme IDs.
visualIssues.fix: Shared feedback owner should map existing variants to current subdued semantic tokens without changing AlertVariant, warning content or theme persistence; verify composed contrast in both themes.

architectureIssues.rule: MDC-032 / workspace scope and source-local pagination
architectureIssues.detail: Page state never resets when vehicleId changes. A user on page 3 of one vehicle requests offset 40 for the next vehicle. If that result is empty, InsightPanel replaces its children, including Pagination, so returning to page 1 is unavailable from this page. Shared Pagination clamps displayed safePage but does not correct caller fetch offset.
architectureIssues.fix: Reset or key pagination by effective vehicle scope and reconcile out-of-range page after totals resolve; keep recovery navigation reachable for an empty out-of-range page. Preserve limit/offset keys and server paging.

priority.reason: Scope-changing pagination can strand users, and the secondary metadata panel conflates unresolved/failure with resolved absence. Restrained visual token cleanup and semantic/overflow improvements follow.

requiredSharedChanges.name: EvidencePanel asynchronous trust propagation

concreteContract.preservation: Keep three subsection headings and static unsupported warnings visible; retain previous quality/evidence/limitations on refresh failure. Reuse InsightPanel/useDataState/SourceContent rather than introduce another state engine.

dependsOn: canonical localization owner if new labels are needed
requiredSharedChanges.evidenceLimit: Other production EvidencePanel consumers were not inspected; no separate composite or broad API migration justified by this one-page audit.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Restrained AlertBanner semantic variants
requiredSharedChanges.evidenceLimit: No page override or token/theme rename authorized; other consumers and rendered colors unverified.

competingImplementations.scope: Inspected page and direct presentation/data dependencies only.
competingImplementations.detail: Existing PageLayout/InsightPanel/SourceContent/dataState migration is already in use. No competing page picker, router, query engine, unit helper, chart library or table pipeline is introduced here. Hand-rendered article/subsection surfaces compete stylistically with shared neutral cards, but are not an independently proven duplicate component system.

sections.name: Finding type/icon, observed time, severity, confidence, explanation
Data quality: status, samples, coverage, observation window, reasons
Evidence sources: source, summary, sample count, observed time
Aggregate limitations and explicit unsupported attribution/intent claims

actions.name: Server page navigation and validated direct jump
actions.detail: First/previous/numbered/next/last where shared responsive controls permit; direct jump remains available. Page size is fixed at 20; no page-size callback supplied.

actions.name: Read full aggregate description help
actions.detail: Tooltip-backed named keyboard button from EvidencePanel description.

actions.name: Workspace vehicle selection
actions.detail: External shell owner, consumed by page; no redundant local picker.

dataBehavior: Preserve vehicle-specific hook key, positive-ID enablement, cancellation, inherited retry/cache policy, fixed page size and backend total/offset semantics.
Retain every returned finding and its explanation/severity/confidence/time; preserve icon classification and severity mapping unless reviewed semantics justify change.
Keep per-finding evidence/limitations separate from aggregate quality/limitations; aggregate evidence is flatMap of the current page only, not an asserted whole-result evidence set.
Retain all non-attribution/unsupported warnings and localized fallbacks; no mutation, acknowledgement, identity attribution or export action exists in this inspected page.
Preserve shared preference-aware numeric formatting and safe shared date fallback; no fake data, unknown-to-zero display conversion or legacy unit helpers.
Preserve existing source-local loading/fatal/retained/paused handling and page/full-width/shared motion migrations rather than revert them.
Response generated_at is in the wire type but not currently displayed; adding freshness UI must not be reported as preservation of an existing display.
No date-range control or bounds exist in this page/hook. Do not invent backend date filtering based on observation-window metadata.

evidenceLimits.scope: Read-only one-page source audit with directly relevant data/presentation owners and route composition. No UI/source changes, Git operations, agents, browser activity, runtime calls or project-wide validation.
evidenceLimits.backend: Known route and handler delegation only; business algorithms, storage/source completeness, freshness, real payloads, authentication behavior and server page edge cases not exercised.
evidenceLimits.localization: Translation calls inspected; canonical key existence, runtime language changes and RTL not tested.
evidenceLimits.auditScript: Read .github\skills\audit-violations\audit.sh but did not execute it: it unconditionally invokes project TypeScript, outside this Phase 0 source-only validation scope. Used scoped source-pattern counts instead.

sourceChecks.method: PowerShell Get-Content/Select-String against the 142-line assigned page only; Get-FileHash SHA256.
sourceChecks.interpretation: Pattern counts are not a complete lint result. No explicit page neon/glow/shadow or pure-white text classes matched. Fixed-white translucent surfaces occur on two page lines; shared AlertBanner has neon-named variants. Dependency glow/saturation/Badge contrast not exhaustively validated.
sourceChecks.failedProbe: An initial PowerShell pattern-count expression failed with ParserError (exit 1) due quote escaping; corrected command completed with exit 0. No source or report was changed by that failed probe.
